text: The caller set a token budget for thinking on each request ( budget_tokens , up to the 128K output limit), the deliberate counter-design to OpenAI's router: the caller owned the cost and latency decision instead of delegating it to a classifier it could not inspect, and with one model there was no capability jump between the fast and slow paths.
